entities.name: Haen
entities.description: Keeper of the Clan Tree of Cridhe during the Parting, who later founded a line of Keepers.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: Haen's childhood friend, who broke the Clan Tree out of jealousy.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: A stranger who gave Nohr the sword Soulslayer.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: A magical sword given to Nohr by Malvos.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: The tree whose green mana gave its Keeper the Sight.

entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: The cataclysm after Nohr split the Clan Tree, fragmenting Cridhe and its people.

entities.name: The Maker
entities.description: Cridhe's creator-god who laid an ancient curse on the land.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Haen's village, named in his honor and defended by a thornwood wall.

events.summary: Haen is chosen as Keeper of the Tree and sworn to protect it; Nohr grows jealous.
events.quote: Nohr grew jealous at his friend's new status.

events.summary: Malvos gives Nohr Soulslayer and Nohr swears to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood.
events.quote: Nohr swore to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood .

events.summary: Nohr splits the Clan Tree despite Haen's protests, causing the Parting and killing the tree.
events.quote: Despite Haen's heavy protesting, Nohr split the tree, causing Haen to fall out of its branches to the ground

events.summary: Haen sleeps frozen in time, then wakes three weeks later with fire in his fingers and reawakens the tree's remnants with a new ritual.
events.quote: Haen woke up and had a fire in his fingers

events.summary: Haen becomes known as the First, a Keeper without a tree, and plants a warded thornwood wall to defend Inys Haen.
events.quote: Haen then became known as the First, a Keeper without a tree to keep

relations.note: former friend who attacked the Tree; his people attack Inys Haen
relations.quote: To defend Inys Haen from semiannual Nohrish attacks
Haen and Nohr were childhood friends.
given the magical sword Soulslayer by the stranger Malvos
